_comment: Referents no channel may hand a word for. A timing fence, not a prohibition -- these stay writable
once you can reproduce them (design 8.3), which is a rung no device can stand in for. Read by the
page loot and by the analysis machine, so neither skips it.
Yema is here (design 7.1.2): the tree's one word, its wood, which a world written of comes out as dead
yema (`Materials.laidAs`). Its other states have no word at all -- see `does_not_have_a_word.json`. The
scarab is the entity half, in `tags/entity_type/withheld.json`. Nara is `compounded_stone`: holding a
block of it is exactly the possession the reproduction rung exists to refuse.
